estimates.assumptions: 6 small eggplants total ~390g edible flesh (typical small Italian/Japanese eggplant ~65g each after trimming minimal stem/end; recipe cooks whole, forking to tenderness, so using raw edible weight here).
½ tbsp harissa paste/spice blend ~7.5g (standard density for thick spice paste; calories left null as known value not supplied and harissa density varies widely).
1 standard can chickpeas = 15 oz / 425g total; ~240g drained edible beans (standard drained yield ~56% of can weight; matches supplied 137 kcal/100g for drained chickpeas).
1.5 cups Greek yogurt; 1 cup = ~230g so 1.5 cups = 345g (standard weight for thick Greek yogurt).
